# GSE analysis using clusterProfiler
I can generate two lists of genes, one for significant association with hypermethylated CpGs and one for hypomethylated cpgs.

```{r}
length(unique(df.sig.EQTm$CpG.id))
unique(df.sig.EQTm$gene.symbol)
```

```{r}
# Load packages
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)  # for human gene annotation
library(enrichplot)
library(ReactomePA)

# If you have gene names and need to convert to Entrez IDs
gene.ids.entrez <- bitr(
  df.sig.EQTm$gene.symbol,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
)

nr.map.entrez.id <- unique(gene.ids.entrez$SYMBOL)
nr.genes.to.use <- unique(df.sig.EQTm$gene.symbol)
total.to.use <- base::intersect(nr.genes.to.use, nr.map.entrez.id)

print("")
print(
  paste0("Total genes to use in enrichment: ", length(total.to.use))
)
```


```{r}
# Create the main GO results directory
GO.result.dir <- file.path(res.dir, "functional_analysis/GO_plots") 
dir.create(GO.result.dir, recursive = TRUE)


# Define the vector of ontology types
ontology_types <- c("BP", "MF", "CC")

# Loop through each ontology type
for (ont_type in ontology_types) {
  
  cat("Processing ontology:", ont_type, "\n")
  
   
  go_enrichment <- enrichGO(
    gene = gene.ids.entrez$ENTREZID,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,  # Relaxed from 0.05
    qvalueCutoff = 0.05,  # Relaxed from 0.05
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",  # Try Benjamini-Hochberg instead of FDR
    ont = ont_type,
    minGSSize = 5,       # Lower minimum gene set size
    maxGSSize = 500      # Ensure you're not excluding small categories
  )
  
  # Check if enrichment results exist
  if (nrow(go_enrichment@result) > 0) {
    
    # Create the dotplot
    p <- dotplot(go_enrichment, showCategory = 30) + 
      theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)) +
      ggtitle(paste("GO Enrichment -", ont_type))
    
    # Create filename with the ontology type
    filename <- file.path(GO.result.dir, paste0("dotplot_GO_", ont_type, ".png"))
    
    # Save the plot
    ggsave(
      filename = filename,
      plot = p,
      width = 8, 
      height = 15,
      dpi = 300,
      units = "in"
    )
    
    cat("Saved plot for", ont_type, "to:", filename, "\n")
    
  } else {
    cat("No significant enrichment found for", ont_type, "\n")
  }
}

cat("GO enrichment analysis completed for all ontology types.\n")
```

```{r}
prepareAnnot <- function(CpG2Gene, geneidtype = "SYMBOL"){
    geneidtype = match.arg(
        geneidtype,c("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL", "ENTREZID", "REFSEQ"))

    if(is.matrix(CpG2Gene)|is.data.frame(CpG2Gene)){
        if(!is.character(CpG2Gene$CpG)){
            stop("CpG ID should be characters")
        }
        if(ncol(CpG2Gene)!=2){
            stop("CpG2Gene should contain two columns")
        }
        FullAnnot = data.frame(CpG2Gene)
    }else if(is.list(CpG2Gene)){
        FullAnnot = data.frame(
            CpG = unlist(CpG2Gene),
            gene = rep(names(CpG2Gene),vapply(CpG2Gene, length, FUN.VALUE = 0)))
    }else{
        stop("CpG2Gene should be a matrix or a data frame or a list.")
    }
    
    colnames(FullAnnot) = c("Name", "UCSC_RefGene_Name")

    if(geneidtype!="SYMBOL"){
        temp = suppressMessages(
            select(org.Hs.eg.db, FullAnnot$UCSC_RefGene_Name,
                        columns = "SYMBOL",keytype = geneidtype))
        FullAnnot$UCSC_RefGene_Name = temp$SYMBOL
    }
    rownames(FullAnnot) = FullAnnot$Name
    return(FullAnnot)
}
```
